frameworks.label: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
frameworks.applicability: Application security verification in a declared scope. Native ASVS verification targets; not national impact levels, organizational maturity, compliance or automatic scan permission.

levels.label: ASVS Level 1
levels.summary: Native cumulative application verification target; 37 curated requirements only, not all Level 1 requirements.

levels.label: ASVS Level 2
levels.summary: Native cumulative application verification target; 37 curated requirements only, not all Level 2 requirements.

levels.label: ASVS Level 3
levels.summary: Native cumulative application verification target; 37 curated requirements only, not all Level 3 requirements.

sources.title: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 pinned official release JSON
sources.locator: v5.0.0_release; commit 5cf9b032440be53ce345ab3c130fda46ba1ce7a2; selected native requirement IDs

limitations: 37 selected requirements out of 345; the remaining native IDs stay unmapped in web-assurance.mjs. The two modules have different curated denominators.
Application verification levels are international assessment targets, not country security grades. No national jurisdiction is inferred.
All selected application requirements require manual review; no scan-only certification is emitted. Feature exclusions require independent review.
Adapted from OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 under CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution and modification details are in research/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

frameworks.label: ISO/IEC 27001 information security management system
frameworks.applicability: An organization chooses an ISMS scope and follows the licensed standard. International ISMS requirements and certification process; no invented security level ladder.

levels.label: ISMS review target (not a security grade)
levels.summary: Placeholder for a licensed scoped requirements review; no curated full-text clause pack.

sources.title: ISO official publication metadata
sources.locator: Edition 3 published 2022-10; full text not reviewed

limitations: Licensed full text has not been reviewed or reproduced. No Annex A controls or exact clause predicates are inferred from the sales overview.
An ISO certificate or a national implementation requires a competent assessment; this harness cannot issue either.
